subject: Version above 1.2.7 causes issue with groupComparisonTMT function

messages.author: 73bd3416264319f5
messages.subject: Version above 1.2.7 causes issue with groupComparisonTMT function
parts:
Hi, 

I am a heavy user of MSstatsTMT and have recently upgraded from version 1.2.7 to version 1.5.6 (Also 1.4.6).

Upon upgrading versions (Up from 1.2.7) I have experienced an issue with MSstatsTMT function groupComparisonTMT. Within the output of groupComparisonTMT I get no Pvalues or Log2FC values and in the "issue" column for all of my proteins I get "unfittableModel". However, using the older version of MSstatsTMT (Version 1.2.7) I am able to get proper statistics (Pvalues and Log2FC values, etc).

To this email I am attaching the input file to groupComparisonTMT as well as the output I get from that function for version 1.2.7 as well as version 1.5.6.

I was wondering if someone could shed some light on why this is happening in the newer versions of MSstatsTMT?

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you,

Trent Hinkle

messages.author: 8c05e04cfce80cdf
messages.subject: Re: Version above 1.2.7 causes issue with groupComparisonTMT function
parts:
Actually, I was just using the example data that comes with the package. I decided to use the "Median" method for protein summarization as that is what I had used previously used with MSstats on LFQ data and was familiar with the calculation. As you can see in the attached screenshot, there are no stats values and the issue says "unfittableModel". 

library(MSstatsTMT)

quant <- PDtoMSstatsTMTFormat(input = raw.pd, annotation = annotation.pd, which.proteinid = 'Protein.Accessions')
quant.median <- proteinSummarization(quant, method="Median", global_norm=TRUE, reference_norm=TRUE, remove_norm_channel = TRUE, remove_empty_channel = TRUE)

comparison=matrix(c(-1,0,0,1),nrow=1)
row.names(comparison)="1-0.125"
colnames(comparison)= c("0.125", "0.5", "0.667", "1")
test.contrast = groupComparisonTMT(data = quant.median,contrast.matrix = comparison, moderated = TRUE)
